topic: Migrating a Codex Task Workflow from native Windows to WSL2
scope: Environment and execution-capability diagnostics only; no Task #65 candidate results

claims.claim: Moving the repository and toolchain into the WSL2 Linux filesystem removed dependence on WindowsApps Python aliases, WinGet-private uv paths, and the Windows host keyring.
support: uv resolved to a WSL-native user path
repository was stored on ext4 under /home

claims.claim: WSL2 reduced tool-visibility problems but did not remove Codex sandbox approval boundaries.
support: temporary Git operations under /tmp completed directly
formal Git metadata writes required approval

claims.claim: An approved proxy-enabled path is reliable enough for the repository workflow, while no-proxy access is only partial.
support: proxy-enabled GitHub, API, gh, and Git operations passed
without proxy, api.github.com passed but github.com and git ls-remote timed out

claims.claim: Approval-required is a documented safety boundary, not an environment failure.
support: formal repository write probe completed and cleaned
reversible GitHub write probe completed and left no ref

before_after_rows.windows: WindowsApps alias was not reliably usable in sandbox
WinGet user-private executable path was not reliably usable
before_after_rows.wsl2: native uv 0.11.28 worked; cache access still required approval

before_after_rows.windows: write operations frequently required elevated execution
before_after_rows.wsl2: complete temporary repository flow under /tmp was direct

before_after_rows.windows: host keyring was not reliably visible to sandbox
before_after_rows.wsl2: independent revocable gh login was verified

success_cases: CI-equivalent validation passed on the WSL2 toolchain.
Disposable formal-repository worktree, add, commit, and branch-switch probe completed and cleaned.
Temporary GitHub ref was created and deleted with no PR or Issue side effect.
failure_cases: Initial gh and HTTPS Git access failed before WSL-local authentication was configured.
Sandbox could not access the local proxy socket or uv cache directly.
No-proxy github.com and git ls-remote timed out.
counterintuitive_cases: A successful WSL migration still leaves approval-required operations because the sandbox boundary is separate from the operating-system boundary.
A missing bare python command is not a missing Python environment when python3 and uv run python are the supported entry points.
Unapproved sandbox network failures cannot by themselves classify the host WSL network.
